name: valem
description: Deterministic reactive state models an agent can create, mutate, read, and verify over MCP.
long_description: Valem gives an agent a spreadsheet-like computation core instead of a text buffer. Create a model from a declarative ModelSpec (schema + JSONata derivations + constraints + effects); write only base fields and Valem recomputes every dependent value in dependency order and enforces every invariant before the change commits. Tools cover create/mutate/read/explain plus pure, offline authoring checks (validate_spec, test_spec, dry_run). Runs embedded and in-memory by default; point it at a running valem-web server for durable, shared state.

api_key.description: API key for the remote valem-web server (only used with a Remote server URL).
